mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(d.amount AS DECIMAL(36, 12))), 0) AS total_amount FROM ( SELECT id, summary_id FROM order_summary ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) s LEFT JOIN order_summary_detail d ON d.summary_id = s.summary_id

SELECT b.balance_id, b.chain_id, b.wallet_id, b.currency_id, c.symbol, b.balance, b.update_time FROM org_user_chain_walet_currency_balance b JOIN org_user_chain_wallet w ON w.wallet_id = b.wallet_id JOIN org_user u ON u.user_id = w.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_currency c ON c.currency_id = b.currency_id WHERE b.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND u.org_id = #{orgId} AND COALESCE(b.is_delete, 0) = 0 ORDER BY b.currency_id
